Title: vector DB.DBA.BAG_OF_NONNULLS_AGG (
Description:
DB.DBA.BAG_OF_NONNULLS_AGG returns a vector of passed values.
    Similar to DB.DBA.VECTOR_OF_NONNULLS_AGG() but ignores NULL arguments.
DB.DBA.BAG_OF_NONNULLS_AGG
The order of items in the vector is not predefined and may vary from run to run.
